name: Backup & Recovery
description: Keep safe copies of important data and check that they can be restored.

name: Access Control & Identity
description: Make sure only the right people can access your data and systems.

name: Patching & Vulnerability Management
description: Keep track of devices and software and fix security weaknesses promptly.

name: Email & Web Security
description: Reduce the chance of harmful messages, websites and remote connections reaching your organisation.

name: Network & Endpoint Security
description: Protect devices and limit how an infection can spread between systems.

name: Detection & Monitoring
description: Watch for warning signs of an attack and make sure someone responds.

name: Incident Response & Recovery Planning
description: Prepare people and practical steps for containing an attack and recovering safely.

name: Awareness & Training
description: Help staff recognise suspicious activity and know how to report it.
